question: Can something unreal have established existence as a subsidiary part of an injunction?
premises: An injunction may require subsidiary elements.
Subsidiary status presupposes some reality or validity.
What is unreal cannot function as a genuine subsidiary.
inference: If existence is only as a subsidiary to injunction, the unreal cannot be established as such a subsidiary.
plain_english: If existence is claimed only as a subsidiary to an injunction, what is unreal cannot be established as a subsidiary.
